source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled Standard Albanian. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Standard Albanian written for learners and may contain unnatural or incorrect phrasing. Every word form was checked by machine against the course's own word list, the UniParser Albanian analyzer and Wiktionary's Albanian tables (npm run sq:check-texts); that is a check of forms, not of naturalness, and forms on which those sources differ are listed in data/review/sq/accepted-differences.json. The English lines are the drafter's own. The text speaks of Christian belief: it needs a native reviewer who can also judge theological wording.

sentences.text: — Dritan, a mund të të pyes diçka?
— Unë besoj se ka një Zot.
sentences.english: "I believe that there is a God.
But I do not know him."

sentences.text: — Unë besoj se Perëndia na do.
Ai e dha Birin e tij për ne.
sentences.english: He gave his Son for us."

sentences.text: Ai vdiq për mëkatet tona dhe u ringjall.
sentences.english: He died for our sins and rose again."

sentences.text: — Mirë. Mund të lexojmë Biblën bashkë.
sentences.english: "Good. We can read the Bible together."
